title: The Resurrection Witnesses
description: After he had risen early on the first day of the week, Jesus appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had previously driven out seven evil spirits. She told those who had been with him, who were now mourning and weeping, but they did not believe her. Then he appeared in another form to two of them while they were walking into the countryside, and they went back and told the others—but even them they did not believe. Finally, he appeared to the eleven while they were at table, and rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they had not believed those who had seen him risen [ref:Mark 16:9-14|Markus 16:9-14].
